spec.rationale: Current DEAD preset carried 2x AGM-65G Maverick (LAU_117_AGM_65G, EO ASM, priority 5). Upgraded to 2x BRU-57 with AGM-154A JSOW ({BRU57_2*AGM-154A}, priority 1: JSOW = best standoff/precision weapon the F-16C can carry — GPS/INS glide, fired from range, low exposure, 4 total JSOWs). Layout based on the known-valid "Escalation Anti-ship" sibling preset which already mounts {BRU57_2*AGM-154A} symmetrically on pylons 3 and 7. Kept symmetric self-defense (AIM-120C on wingtips 1/9, AIM-9X on 2/8), symmetric 370 gal fuel tanks (4/6), ALQ-184 ECM pod (5), AN/AAQ-33 Sniper ATP (11), and AN/ASQ-213 HTS sensor (10). JSOW is GPS/INS-guided so no targeting pod is strictly required, but the ATP is retained per sibling presets and is harmless. No anti-radar weapons present (HTS is a sensor pod, not a weapon — fine). No cluster/dumb/decoy/rockets, no asymmetry.
spec.concerns: All 11 (num, CLSID) pairs verified against the pydcs pylon-compatibility map for F-16C_50: {BRU57_2*AGM-154A} is valid on pylons 3 and 7; fuel tank {F376DBEE...} on 4/6; ALQ_184 on 5; AIM-9X on 2/8; AIM-120C on 1/9; AN_AAQ_33 on 11; AN_ASQ_213 on 10. The HTS pod (AN/ASQ-213) is a SEAD targeting sensor; it is not a weapon and does not violate the no-anti-radar rule, and was already on the prior DEAD/Strike/Anti-ship presets, so it is kept.

spec.rationale: Original DEAD carried 4x AGM-65F Maverick (EO ASM, priority tier 5) on the four wing stations (2/3/6/7), 2x AGM-122 Sidearm on 1/8, and a LITENING pod on 5. The AV-8B has no JSOW/cruise/SLAM/Kh-59 in its inventory; its best available standoff PGM is the GPS-glide GBU-32(V)2/B JDAM (tier 4), an upgrade over Maverick. Swapped all four Mavericks for GBU_32_V_2B on pylons 2/3/6/7 (symmetric, 2 per side) — this exact layout is taken from the known-valid sibling presets "Escalation Strike" and "Escalation OCA/Runway", which already mount GBU_32_V_2B on those stations with the LITENING on pylon 5. JDAM is GPS-guided so no laser pod is strictly required, but the centerline LITENING (A111396E...) is kept per the standard Harrier config and the designer hint. The 2x AGM-122 Sidearm on 1/8 are PRESERVED per the hard exception (short-range anti-radiation already on the original DEAD; not added new), giving the AI light self-defense without violating the no-anti-radar-as-DEAD-weapon rule. Result is fully symmetric. Every (pylon, CLSID) pair validated against the pydcs AV8BNA pylon map: GBU_32_V_2B valid on 2/3/6/7, LITENING valid on 5, AGM_122_SIDEARM valid on 1/8.
spec.concerns: The Harrier has no air-to-air missile in this loadout (the AIM-9 wingtip stations are pylons 1/8, which are occupied by the kept Sidearms; pydcs shows AIM-9L only on tip pylons 1/8). Keeping the Sidearms per the hint means forgoing dedicated AA, matching the original DEAD which also had no AIM-9. No external fuel tank is fitted (drop tank {AV8BNA_AERO1D} only fits inner wing pylons 2/3/6/7, which are needed for the 4 JDAMs); the original DEAD also carried no fuel tank, so this is consistent.

pylons.weapon: LAU-88 with 2 x AGM-65D - Maverick D (IIR ASM)
LAU-88 with 2 x AGM-65D - Maverick D (IIR ASM)

spec.rationale: The current DEAD preset carries 4x Mk-84 dumb 2000lb bombs (CLSID {AB8B8299...}) on pylons 1,2,8,9 - no standoff capability and high exposure. The best valid DEAD weapon the F-4E can actually carry per the priority ladder is the AGM-65 Maverick (EO/laser ASM, priority 5). No JSOW/cruise/Kh-59/SLAM/JDAM/KAB are available on this airframe; GBU-10/12 LGBs (priority 6, lower) exist on pylons 1/9 but the F-4E carries no laser designator/targeting pod in any of its Escalation presets, so a laser weapon is not usable. I chose AGM-65D (IIR/infrared imaging) over AGM-65K (CCD) because IIR is fire-and-forget, needs no targeting pod, and works at night/in low visibility - ideal for low-exposure DEAD. pydcs confirms the Maverick stations are the two inner wing pylons 2 and 8, each carrying a LAU-88 dual launcher = 4 Mavericks total, mounted symmetrically. The station-specific CLSIDs differ left/right (...452 on pylon 2, ...453 on pylon 8) and were taken directly from pydcs for each pylon. I kept the existing ALQ-131 ECM pod (pylon 3), the F-4 centerline fuel tank (pylon 5), and 3x AIM-7M Sparrow self-defense missiles in the fuselage wells (pylons 4,6,7) - exactly matching the validated Escalation Strike/SEAD/DEAD fuselage layout for this airframe. The Mavericks occupy the AIM-9 wing stations, so AA self-defense is provided by the recessed Sparrows. Pylons 1 and 9 (outer wing) are left empty since they cannot mount the Maverick and a clean symmetric standoff loadout does not need additional dumb stores. No anti-radar weapons (the airframe's SEAD preset uses AGM-45 Shrike) are present, no cluster/rockets/decoys. Per the designer hint: dumb Mk-84 -> AGM-65 Maverick, keep AIM-7 + ECM, no Shrike.
spec.concerns: The F-4E has four AIM-7 fuselage wells (pylons 3,4,6,7). Pylon 3 is used by the ALQ-131 ECM pod (consistent with the airframe's other Escalation presets), leaving 3 Sparrows on 4,6,7. The Sparrow count is inherently odd because of the ECM pod; this mirrors the existing Strike/SEAD/DEAD presets and the recessed fuselage stations are not visually asymmetric. The Maverick (the load-bearing DEAD weapon) and the ECM pod are fully symmetric. Every (pylon, CLSID) pair was validated against pydcs for the F-4E.

spec.rationale: The F-14A (Heatblur) has no JSOW, cruise, Kh-59, SLAM, JDAM, or Maverick in its inventory (confirmed via pydcs pylon enumeration). The best DEAD-capable precision weapon it carries is the GBU-24 laser-guided bomb (priority ladder rung 6). GBU-24 ({BRU-32 GBU-24}) is valid only on pylons 4 and 6 per pydcs, which form a symmetric pair and exactly match the GBU-24 placement in the ship's own ANTISHIP sibling preset. The LANTIRN Targeting Pod ({F14-LANTIRN-TP}) is required to lase the GBU-24 and is valid on pylon 9 (used by STRIKE/BAI/ANTISHIP presets). Self-defense AIM-9M on wingtip pylons 1+10 (symmetric) and 300 gal fuel tanks on pylons 3+8 (symmetric) follow every other preset. Pylon 2 (mirror of the LANTIRN station 9) is left empty rather than mounting a lone unbalanced AIM-7, keeping the loadout fully symmetric. The previous DEAD preset was an air-to-air fit (2x AIM-54C Phoenix + AIM-7 + Zuni LAU-10 rocket pods + fuel) with no real anti-SAM standoff weapon, so it is replaced. Removed: AIM-54/AIM-7 air-to-air missiles and the PHXBRU3242 Zuni rocket pods (rockets disallowed). No HARM/anti-radar or decoy stores were present.
spec.concerns: GBU-24 is a laser-guided bomb (the lowest standoff rung), the ceiling of this airframe's A/G capability. It requires LOS/lasing exposure, but with LANTIRN it gives the F-14A meaningful PGM standoff for DEAD. The mirror shoulder pylon 2 is intentionally left empty to preserve weapon symmetry, since pylon 9 is occupied by the mandatory targeting pod and a single Sparrow there would be asymmetric.

spec.rationale: Current DEAD preset carried only AIM-54C Phoenix + AIM-7 (pure A2A, no air-to-ground weapon) — invalid for DEAD, must upgrade. The F-14A (Heatblur) has no JSOW/cruise/SLAM/JDAM/Maverick/Kh-series weapons in pydcs; its best precision option is the GBU-24 LGB (priority ladder rung 6). GBU-24 is laser-guided and needs a designator, which the LANTIRN pod provides. Layout copied from the known-valid ANTISHIP sibling preset: GBU-24 mounted symmetrically on inner wing pylons 4 and 6, LANTIRN on pylon 9, AIM-9M self-defense on wingtips (pylons 1 and 10), and 2x 300gal fuel tanks (pylons 3 and 8). Removed the ANTISHIP preset's ADM-141 TALD decoys and LAU-10 Zuni rocket pods per DEAD requirements. Every (pylon, CLSID) pair validated via pydcs against F-14A-135-GR-Early: pylon 4 and 6 both list {BRU-32 GBU-24}; pylon 9 lists {F14-LANTIRN-TP}; pylons 1/10 list {LAU-138 wtip - AIM-9M}; pylons 3/8 list {F14-300gal}. Note: pylon 7 does NOT offer GBU-24, so the symmetric pair is correctly 4/6 (not 4/7). No ECM pod added — the F-14A jammer (ALQ-167) occupies a weapon station and conflicts with this clean symmetric combat loadout.
spec.concerns: F-14A is hard-limited to LGBs for precision A2G, so the DEAD aircraft must close to laser-designation range (no true standoff). This is the best the airframe can carry; standoff is impossible on this platform.

spec.rationale: Current DEAD preset is junk for the role: it carries LAU-10 Zuni rocket pods ({PHXBRU3242_2*LAU10 LS/RS}), which are unguided rockets (no standoff, disallowed) plus a CAP loadout of AIM-54/AIM-7. The F-14B (Heatblur) cannot carry any JSOW/cruise/SLAM/JDAM/Maverick — its only PGM options are laser-guided bombs (GBU-24/16/12) with the F14-LANTIRN-TP pod. GBU-24 Paveway III is the longest-range/heaviest LGB available, matching the designer hint. I based the layout on the known-valid ANTISHIP sibling (which already mounts {BRU-32 GBU-24} on pylons 4 & 6 with LANTIRN on pylon 9), then removed its TALD decoys ({BRU3242_ADM141}). Final loadout: 2x GBU-24 symmetric on the belly tunnel (4,6), LANTIRN pod (9) for laser designation, 2x AIM-9M on the wingtips (1,10) for self-defense, 1x AIM-7MH on the left shoulder (2) to balance the LANTIRN, and symmetric 300gal fuel tanks (3,8). All eight (num,CLSID) pairs validated against pydcs F-14B pylon tables: GBU-24 confirmed only on 4/6, LANTIRN only on 9, AIM-9M wingtips only on 1/10, fuel only on 3/8 — every pair is present. No rockets/cluster/dumb/decoy/anti-radar weapons remain.
spec.concerns: The LANTIRN pod is only mountable on pylon 9 (right shoulder), so the shoulder pair (pylon 2 = AIM-7MH vs pylon 9 = LANTIRN) is not item-for-item mirrored. This is unavoidable on the F-14B and is exactly how every stock A-G sibling preset (STRIKE/CAS/ANTISHIP) is built. The primary DEAD weapons (GBU-24), the AA self-defense (AIM-9M), and the fuel tanks are all perfectly symmetric. GBU-24 is a laser bomb (rung 6, the worst tier) but it is the best the airframe can physically carry, and the required laser designation pod (LANTIRN) is present.

spec.rationale: The Tornado GR4 has no JSOW/cruise/JDAM/Maverick/Kh-29 in its pylon inventory, so per the priority ladder the best DEAD weapon it can actually carry is a laser-guided bomb. GBU-16 (1000lb) is the heaviest LGB available and mounts only on pylons 4 and 9 (verified via pydcs), giving a clean symmetric 2x load. Laser guidance requires a designation pod: the AN/AAQ-28 LITENING is carried on pylon 5 (valid). Self-defense is 2x AIM-9M on the symmetric AA stations 3/10, fuel on the symmetric tank stations 2/11, plus the Sky-Shadow ECM jammer (pylon 1) and BOZ-107 chaff/flare dispenser (pylon 12) that the Tornado normally carries. The old DEAD preset was rebuilt: it carried ALARM (anti-radar = SEAD, forbidden for DEAD) on pylons 10/3 and BL-755 cluster bombs (forbidden) on pylons 6/7/8, with no PGM and no AA missiles -- so this is a substantive upgrade. All 9 (num, CLSID) pairs validate against the pydcs Tornado GR4 pylon options; CLSIDs were taken from sibling presets (BOZ/fuel/ECM/LITENING/AIM-9M) and from the pydcs-confirmed GBU-16 option on pylons 4/9.
spec.concerns: Pylon 5 is occupied by the LITENING pod (the only pod-capable station), so the centerline GBU-12 stations are not used for bombs; the GBU-16 sits on the heavier shoulder pylons 4/9 instead, which is the better LGB anyway. No JDAM/JSOW exists for this airframe in pydcs, so LGB is genuinely the ceiling.

spec.rationale: Current DEAD preset carries GBU-31(V)3/B JDAM (GPS glide bomb, priority rank 4). The F-15ESE can carry AGM-154A JSOW (priority rank 1 - the top standoff/glide weapon), so this is a clear upgrade per the designer hint. Layout is based on the known-valid sibling "Escalation Strike"/"Escalation DEAD" pylon arrangement: I swapped the four JDAM/CFT-JDAM bomb stations for single AGM-154A JSOW on pylons 2, 4, 12, 14 (symmetric: 4/12 inner CFT + 2/14 outer wing), and kept everything else identical - AIM-120C on 1/15, AIM-9M on 3/13, AN/AAQ-13 NAV pod on 9, AN/AAQ-14 TGT pod on 7, and one 610gal fuel tank on 8. JSOW is GPS/INS-guided so no laser pod is required, but the LANTIRN pods are kept since the F-15E always carries them (matches all other Escalation presets) and they are harmless. No HARM/anti-radar, no cluster, no decoys, no dumb bombs. Every (num, CLSID) pair was validated against pydcs's F-15ESE pylon allow-lists: AGM-154A is permitted on pylons 2/4/8/12/14; I used 2/4/12/14 to keep it symmetric while preserving the fuel tank on 8.
spec.concerns: The F-15ESE module only offers AGM-154A (JSOW CEB cluster-type submunition) - no AGM-154B/C variant and no CFT multi-JSOW rack exists in its pylon set, so only 4 JSOW (one per station) instead of the 8 JDAM the old preset carried. AGM-154A's anti-armor submunitions are still effective and standoff against SAM sites. This is acceptable and remains the highest-priority weapon available.

issues: No blockers. All 11 (pylon, CLSID) pairs validate against pydcs F-15ESE allow-lists. AGM-154A is permitted on pylons 2/4/8/12/14; the design uses 2/4/12/14 (keeping fuel on 8) - valid.

Weapon choice is optimal: AGM-154A JSOW is priority rank 1. Confirmed via pydcs that the F-15ESE module has NO AGM-154C, no cruise missile, no SLAM-ER, and no multi-JSOW rack - JSOW-A is the best available standoff weapon. Correct upgrade from the old GBU-31 JDAM (rank 4) preset.
JSOW is GPS/INS-guided (not laser), so no targeting pod is required; LANTIRN NAV+TGT pods are kept anyway and are harmless. Not a blocker.
Loadout is symmetric: JSOW on 4/12 (inner CFT pair) and 2/14 (outer wing pair) per F-15E centerline-symmetric numbering; AIM-120C on 1/15; AIM-9M on 3/13; single 610gal tank on centerline pylon 8.

No anti-radar weapon (no HARM/Shrike/ALARM/Kh-58/Kh-31P), no TALD decoys, no rockets, no dumb bombs. The AGM-154A 'CEB (CBU-type)' is the top-priority standoff glide weapon, not a free-fall cluster bomb.
Minor/informational only: F-15E has no dedicated ECM pod in its pylon set (uses internal TEWS), so none is expected or missing.
Standoff weapon is actually present: 4x AGM-154A JSOW.

spec.rationale: The B-2 is a mod airframe not in pydcs (id2['B2_Spirit'] -> not found), so I validated each (pylon, CLSID) pair against other presets in the same B2_Spirit.lua, which use a two-bay abstraction: num 1 and num 2 each carry one quantity-bundled CLSID. The old DEAD preset was dumb GBU-27 (LGB) + CBU-97 (cluster) -- both disallowed for a standoff DEAD loadout. JSOW (AGM-154C) is the top of the weapon-priority ladder and the B-2 already carries the bundle {B2_AGM-154C*8} in three sibling presets (Strike, SEAD, SEAD Sweep), all on pylon num 1. I therefore mirror the known-valid Escalation Strike layout: {B2_AGM-154C*8} on bay 1 (8 JSOW) + {B2_GBU-38*40} (GBU-38 JDAM, GPS-guided) on bay 2. Both are precision/standoff weapons appropriate for DEAD; neither is laser-guided so no targeting pod is needed (and the B-2 carries none in any preset). The B-2 has no AA missiles, fuel tanks, or ECM pods in any preset (internal-bay stealth bomber), so none are added. No anti-radar weapons present. CRITICAL VALIDATION CONSTRAINT: {B2_AGM-154C*8} appears ONLY on pylon num 1 across all presets and is NEVER carried on pylon num 2; pylon num 2 has only ever held GBU/CBU/Mk bombs. So JSOW cannot be validly placed in both bays -- doing so would invent an unverified pairing. The best validated second-bay weapon is the GPS JDAM bundle {B2_GBU-38*40} (validated on num 2 in presets 2 and 7), which is ladder rank 4 and fully DEAD-appropriate. This is an upgrade: dumb LGB + cluster -> JSOW + JDAM, both precision.
spec.concerns: Per-pylon "symmetry" in the literal left/right sense does not apply to this airframe: it is modeled as two weapons bays each holding a different quantity-bundled CLSID, and no preset ever shares the same bundle across both bays. {B2_AGM-154C*8} is only validated on bay 1, so bay 2 uses the next-best validated precision weapon (GPS JDAM {B2_GBU-38*40}) rather than a second JSOW bundle. If the mod actually accepts {B2_AGM-154C*8} on pylon num 2, a dual-JSOW (16 total) loadout would be marginally better, but that pairing is not verifiable from the available data (B-2 not in pydcs and no mod payload file under IncomingMods), so I did not use it. The chosen layout exactly matches the known-valid Escalation Strike preset.

spec.rationale: Su-30 is a standard pydcs airframe (id2['Su-30'] resolves). Best valid standoff weapon per the priority ladder is the Kh-59M (AS-18 Kazoo, IN-guided, tier 3); the airframe has no JSOW, no cruise missile (no Kh-65/Kh-101/Kh-59MK2), only TV/laser glide bombs (KAB-500Kr/1500Kr/KAB-500LG, tier 4) which are lower priority. The existing SEAD preset uses Kh-31P (anti-radar) which is forbidden for DEAD. Layout mirrors the STRIKE/CAP siblings: ECM pods on outer pylons 1/10, R-73 IR on 2/9, R-77 active-radar AA filling wing stations 4-7, and the Kh-59M mounted symmetrically on the heavy inner pylons 3 & 8 (the only two that accept it). Kh-59M is inertial-guided so no targeting pod is required. All 10 (num, clsid) pairs confirmed valid via pydcs Pylon membership. Designer hint (Kh-59M + R-73/R-77 + ECM symmetric) matched the real data exactly. No DEAD preset existed previously, so action=add.
spec.concerns: Only 2 Kh-59M can be carried (pylons 3 & 8 are the only Kh-59M-capable stations), which is correct for the heavy 930kg missile and is a realistic Su-30 standoff loadout. The airframe normally does not carry dedicated external fuel tanks in the existing presets (none of the 6 sibling presets mount a tank), so none added.

spec.rationale: Su-25T has no JSOW/cruise/Kh-59/SLAM. Best available standoff precision weapon on the priority ladder is the GPS/EO-glide tier: KAB-500Kr (TV-guided 500kg bomb), which outranks the Kh-29T/Kh-29L/Kh-25ML EO-laser ASMs and S-25L laser rockets also present. KAB-500Kr aims via the Su-25T's built-in Shkval EO/TV sight, so NO external targeting pod is needed and it is not laser-guided. pydcs confirms KAB-500Kr ({E2C426E3...}) is only carriable on pylons 5 and 7, which form a symmetric inner pair. Built a real combat loadout from the STRIKE/OCA siblings: 2x KAB-500Kr (5/7), 2x R-73 self-defense IR missiles (2/10), 2x MPS-410 ECM jammer pods on the wingtip stations (1/11, the dedicated ECM mounts), and 2x symmetric 800L fuel tanks (3/9). Removed all anti-radar weapons from the SEAD/ANTISHIP siblings (Kh-58U, Kh-25MP, Kh-25MPU) since those are SEAD not DEAD; no cluster/dumb bombs, rockets, or decoys included. Every (num, CLSID) pair validated against pydcs Su-25T pylon tables.
spec.concerns: KAB-500Kr only fits pylons 5 and 7, so 2 rounds is the max symmetric quantity. Fuel tanks placed on 3/9; the centerline pylon 6 only accepts ELINT/LLTV recon pods (not needed for the Shkval-guided TV bomb) so it is left empty. The MPS-410 is a self-protection jammer (two distinct left/right CLSIDs ...A82D / ...A82C) tied to the wingtip stations 1 and 11, matching every other Escalation preset in this file.

spec.rationale: Su-17M4 cannot carry any tier 1-4 weapon (no JSOW/cruise/Kh-59/GPS-glide). Best available is tier 5 EO/laser ASM. Between the options (Kh-29L laser, Kh-29T TV, Kh-25ML laser), Kh-29L is best: 657kg warhead with far greater range/lethality than the 300kg Kh-25ML, and the airframe's built-in Klen-PS laser designator self-illuminates it, so no external pod is needed (satisfies the laser-weapon pod requirement via built-in designation). Per pydcs, Kh-29L {3468C652-...} is valid ONLY on pylons 3 and 6 (a symmetric inner-wing pair), so 2x Kh-29L mounted symmetrically. R-60M {APU-60-1_R_60M} is valid on wingtip pylons 2 and 7 (self-defense AA, symmetric). Fuel tank 800L {A5BAEAB7-...} is valid on centerline pylons 4 and 5 (symmetric), matching the airframe's normal config. Outer pylons 1 and 8 left empty (cannot mount Kh-29; adding bombs/rockets would violate the no-junk rule). Removed all anti-radar weapons (the original SEAD preset's Kh-25MPU/Kh-58U are SEAD, not DEAD). Every (num,clsid) pair validated against pydcs Su-17M4 pylon tables.
spec.concerns: Kh-29L/Kh-29T are restricted to pylons 3 and 6 only in pydcs, so the heavy ASM count is capped at 2 (cannot quad-load). SPS-141 ECM pod exists for the airframe but is not mounted because pylons 3/6 (weapon) and 4/5 (fuel) are occupied; standard weapon+AA+fuel symmetry was prioritized. Kh-29L requires the pilot/AI to lase the target with the built-in Klen designator; range is moderate (~10km) so standoff is limited compared to true PGM/cruise airframes, but it is the best this Cold War strike jet can do.

pylons.weapon: APU-60-1M with R-60M (AA-8 Aphid-B) - IR AAM
APU-60-1M with R-60M (AA-8 Aphid-B) - IR AAM

spec.rationale: Best valid DEAD weapon on the MiG-27K is the KAB-500Kr (TV/EO-guided GPS-glide-tier precision bomb, ladder tier 4). Available A2G options were: KAB-500Kr (TV), Kh-29L (laser ASM, tier 5), Kh-25MPU/MP (anti-radar = SEAD, forbidden), and dumb/cluster/rocket stores (junk). KAB-500Kr outranks Kh-29L on the ladder AND is fire-and-forget needing no targeting pod (the MiG-27K has no pod pylon; its Kaira-23 is built-in but irrelevant since KAB-500Kr is TV-self-homing). Layout is based on the known-valid STRIKE sibling preset, which already mounts KAB-500Kr symmetrically on pylons 2/8; kept the centerline 800L fuel tank (pylon 5, as in STRIKE/SEAD/ANTISHIP) and added symmetric R-60M IR AAMs on pylons 3/7 (APU-60-1M, present on CAP/OCA/ANTISHIP) for self-defense. No anti-radar, cluster, dumb bombs, rockets, or decoys. All five (num,clsid) pairs validated via pydcs: KAB-500Kr valid on pylons 2 & 8, R-60M (APU-60-1_R_60M) valid on pylons 3 & 7, 800L tank valid on pylon 5.
spec.concerns: The MiG-27K has no ECM/jammer pod option in pydcs, so none is fitted (the airframe relies on its native RWR/defenses). The R-60M (R-60 2L/2R twin-rail variants also exist) was chosen as the single-rail APU-60-1M to match the OCA/Runway sibling preset; a twin-rail option exists but a single per side is sufficient for self-defense and avoids overloading the small wing-glove pylons alongside the heavy KAB-500Kr/fuel load.

pylons.weapon: LAU-7 with RB-24J (AIM-9P3) Sidewinder IR AAM
LAU-7 with RB-24J (AIM-9P3) Sidewinder IR AAM

spec.rationale: The AJS-37 Viggen has no JSOW, cruise missile, JDAM/GPS glide, or SLAM-class weapon in its inventory. Per the priority ladder, the best valid DEAD weapon it can actually carry is the Rb-75A (AGM-65A Maverick), an EO/TV-guided ASM (priority 5), matching the designer hint. Maverick is TV-guided, not laser-guided, so NO targeting pod is required (and the Viggen has none). I based the layout on the existing CAS sibling preset (known-valid): 4x Rb-75 mounted symmetrically on the four wing/fuselage stations (pylons 2,3,5,6), 2x Rb-24J (AIM-9P3) IR Sidewinders for self-defense on the wingtip rails (pylons 1,7), and 1x external fuel tank on the centerline (pylon 4) which the Viggen normally carries. No anti-radar (the SEAD preset's BK90 cluster munitions were excluded), no cluster/dumb bombs, no decoys. All seven (pylon num, CLSID) pairs validated via pydcs: pylons 2,3,5,6 accept {RB75}; pylons 1,7 accept {Robot24J}; pylon 4 accepts {VIGGEN_X-TANK}.
spec.concerns: Maverick is a shorter-ranged EO weapon (priority 5), so standoff exposure is higher than with JSOW/cruise, but it is the best the airframe can carry. The Viggen has no ECM/jammer pod station, so none is added.

spec.rationale: No DEAD preset exists, so add one. Best EO/laser ASM the base Su-25 can carry is the Kh-29L (priority tier 5, EO/laser ASM); JSOW/cruise/JDAM-class weapons are not available on this airframe. Kh-29L is valid only on the two heavy inner pylons (5/6) per pydcs and the sibling ANTISHIP/SEAD presets, so it is mounted 2x there symmetrically. The four mid pylons (3/4/7/8) carry 4x Kh-25ML (also laser ASM) for additional precision shots, symmetric. Wingtips (1/10) carry 2x R-60M for self-defense. The Su-25 has a built-in Klen laser rangefinder/designator, so no external targeting pod is needed for the laser-guided ASMs (has_designation_pod = built-in). This layout is the known-valid SEAD sibling with the S-25L laser rockets dropped. No anti-radar weapons present (the original SEAD preset's Kh-25ML/Kh-29L are EO/laser, not anti-radiation). No fuel tanks: the laser-ASM siblings (ANTISHIP/SEAD) do not carry them and the limited pylon count is better used for weapons. No cluster/dumb/rockets/decoys. Every (num, clsid) pair validated against pydcs Su-25 pylon map.
spec.concerns: Base Su-25 has no GPS/cruise/JSOW capability; Kh-29L (laser ASM) is the ceiling of the priority ladder it can reach. spec.weapon: GBU-16 (rejected: no laser designation pod available)
spec.concerns: The VSN Tornado IDS (pydcs id "Tornado IDS", an FC-level/simplified-PFM mod) cannot sensibly carry any DEAD weapon. Its entire mountable A2G inventory per pydcs is: GBU-16 LGB (pylons 4 & 9), Kormoran ASM (pylons 2/4/9/11), AGM-88C HARM (pylons 2/4/9/11), and Mk-82 dumb bombs (pylons 5-8). Walking the priority ladder: no JSOW/Kh-59MK2, no cruise, no SLAM/Kh-59M, no JDAM/KAB, no Maverick/Kh-29/Kh-25, so the only precision option is the laser-guided GBU-16. But per the rules an LGB requires a laser designation pod, and NO targeting pod is mountable on ANY Tornado IDS pylon (verified via pydcs per-pylon dump: no LITENING/Sniper/LANTIRN/Pave Spike/ATFLIR; the mod's UnitPayloads LUA at "IncomingMods\\VSN_Tornado v2.9.7.X01 FC PFM\\Mods\\aircraft\\VSN_Tornado\\VSN_TornadoIDS.lua" confirms no TGP pylon entry). The rule says fall back to a non-laser weapon if no pod exists, but there is no valid non-laser DEAD weapon: AGM-88C HARM is anti-radar (SEAD, forbidden for DEAD), Kormoran is a radar-homing ANTI-SHIP missile (not a land SAM-site weapon), and Mk-82 are unguided dumb bombs (forbidden). Therefore no sensible DEAD loadout can be built and no "Escalation DEAD" preset should be added. The existing STRIKE preset already mounts the GBU-16 (pylons 9 & 4) with Sky-Shadow ECM + BOZ-107 + 2x AIM-9M + 2x fuel tanks; if a DEAD preset were ever forced despite the missing pod, it would mirror that STRIKE layout (pylon1 Sky-Shadow {8C3F26A2...}, pylon12 Sky-Shadow, pylon3/10 AIM-9M {6CEB49FC...}, pylon2/11 TORNADO Fuel tank {EF124821...}, pylon4/9 GBU-16 {0D33DDAE...}) but I am NOT recommending that because the LGB has no designation source on this FC airframe.
spec.rationale: action=leave. Per the designer hint "GBU-16 LGB but ONLY if it has a valid laser designation pod; otherwise pick a non-laser option or return action=leave with concern." Validated via pydcs (id "Tornado IDS" resolves) that the only precision A2G weapon mountable is the laser-guided GBU-16, and that zero targeting/designation pods are mountable on any of its 12 pylons. The only other A2G options are forbidden for DEAD (AGM-88C HARM = SEAD anti-radar; Kormoran = anti-ship; Mk-82 = dumb bombs). With no laser designator and no valid non-laser alternative, no sensible DEAD preset can be created, so I leave it unchanged.

spec.rationale: The JF-17 (Deka mod) IS in pydcs, so all pylon-weapon pairs were validated via the pydcs compatibility dump. Best standoff/precision weapon per the ladder: the GB-6 (DIS_GB6) is a GPS/INS-guided stand-off glide dispenser (~60km range) — the longest-reach precision weapon the airframe carries, slotting into the JSOW/glide-bomb top tier. It is fire-and-forget GPS (no targeting pod needed), and it mounts symmetrically on pylons 3 and 5. Chosen GB-6 over alternatives: LS-6-500 is also GPS-glide but shorter/non-dispenser; CM-802AKG is a TV/datalink anti-ship ASM that requires the DATA-LINK POD and is shorter-ranged; GBU-10/12/16 are laser bombs needing the WMD7 pod and far less standoff. The anti-radiation LD-10 was excluded (that is a SEAD weapon, not DEAD). Loadout mirrors the STRIKE sibling but with GB-6 on the deep pylons: 2x GB-6 (pylons 3/5, symmetric), 2x PL-5EII AA self-defense (pylons 1/7, symmetric), 2x 800L fuel tanks (pylons 2/6, symmetric), and the KG-600 (SPJ) ECM jammer pod on the centerline pylon 4. No cluster/dumb bombs, rockets, decoys, or asymmetry. Every (num, CLSID) pair confirmed present in the pydcs pylon list for the JF-17: P1 DIS_PL-5EII, P2 DIS_TANK800, P3 DIS_GB6, P4 DIS_SPJ_POD, P5 DIS_GB6, P6 DIS_TANK800, P7 DIS_PL-5EII.
spec.concerns: GB-6 has TSP/SFW (cluster-submunition) and HE variants; I selected the standard unitary DIS_GB6 which is appropriate vs a SAM site. The JF-17 had no prior Escalation DEAD preset, hence action=add.

No fuel tank is carried because pylons 2/10 (the only PTB-capable wing stations) are occupied by the symmetric Maverick pair; this is an acceptable short-legged strike loadout.
